description: List the URLs of a website without reading them: robots.txt, sitemaps and sitemap indexes plus homepage links, up to 1,000 same-site URLs with lastmod and source. A cheap first step to decide which pages to read with web-read-batch or site-crawl. Returns no page content. Params: url (site or domain, required), max_urls (1 to 1000, default 200). Price: $0.0025 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://agentsvc.io","max_urls":50}.
name: site_map
